title: UPS Foundation Professor of Service Management
bio: Speed has gotten a bad name in business, much of it deserved. When “move fast and break things” began to define the innovation economy, the mindset fueled a widely held belief that we can either make progress or take care of people, one or the other. In Move Fast & Fix Things , leadership experts Frances Frei and Anne Morriss argue that this belief is deeply flawed—and that it keeps you from building a winning company. Helping executives and entrepreneurs solve their toughest problems over the past decade, Frances and Anne learned that the trade-off between speed and excellence is false . The best change leaders solve hard problems with fierce urgency while making their stakeholders—employees, customers, and shareholders—better off.
